movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Crafty Shield
movelist.effect: If the user or an Ally within 2 meters of Crafty Shield’s user is hit by a Status Move, you may use Crafty Shield as an Interrupt. All targets in Crafty Shield’s area- of-effect including the user, are instead not hit by the triggering Move and do not suffer any of its effects.

movelist.name: Haze
movelist.effect: The Combat Stages of the user and all Pokémon and Trainers in the encounter are set to their default state (usually 0).

movelist.name: Night Shade
movelist.effect: The target loses Hit Points equal to the level of Night Shade’s user. Do not apply weakness or resistance. Do not apply stats.

movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

abilities.name: Wandering Spirit
abilities.effect: The user exchanges Wandering Spirit with a random Ability of the opposing Pokémon, as per the Move Skill Swap.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Execute Keyword. If a single source of Damage or Hit Point Loss would cause the user to lose more than X Hit Points, the damage or Hit Point loss is instead reduced to X. X is equal to 50% of their Max Hit Points. Defensive.
